title: SXSW Pitch 2027
summary: SXSW's startup pitch competition, March 16-17, 2027 at the Hilton Austin. Regular entry is $225 (nonrefundable; early-bird ended Sept 13). SXSW's Pitch page gives a final deadline of Nov 13, 2026 but its support center says Nov 11, so applying by Nov 11 is safest.
why_relevant: Texas's highest-visibility startup pitch stage; worth it if Sooz or an AI side project wants national exposure.

title: Vesuvius Challenge $1M Grand Prize (2027)
summary: Open machine-learning and computer-vision competition to read the carbonized Herculaneum scrolls. A new $1M grand prize goes to the first team to fully unroll and make readable another complete eligible scroll using no more than eight hours of human input; deadline June 25, 2027. Other open prizes run alongside it.
why_relevant: A rare big-prize open problem mixing AI, archaeology and history; anyone can join remotely.

title: ARC Prize 2026
summary: $2M in prizes across three tracks for progress on the ARC-AGI reasoning benchmark; entries are Kaggle notebooks and winners must open-source their solutions. Submissions due Nov 2, 2026; papers due Nov 8; results announced Dec 4.
why_relevant: Headline AI-reasoning competition; the paper track lets a curious builder contribute ideas without topping the leaderboard.
